capabilities: Export a Longform project to a structured EPUB in one command, in scene order
Export a folder of chapter notes to EPUB in natural-sorted filename order
Render wikilinks as plain text and embed image embeds into the EPUB
Strip frontmatter and callouts while keeping blockquotes and bold/italic formatting
Configure author name, language, output folder, and book title in settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists v0.2.0 limitations: no print-PDF export, non-image note embeds are skipped, and nested Longform scenes are flattened.
intentEvidence: usually means a separate paid tool (Vellum, Atticus) or a fragile export chain
motivation: The author wanted to handle the common case of exporting a manuscript to EPUB cleanly, instead of paying for a separate tool or stitching together a fragile export chain.
problem: Getting a properly formatted EPUB out of Obsidian normally requires a separate paid tool like Vellum or Atticus or a fragile export chain.

relations.evidence: Run "Export Longform project to EPUB" and you get a properly structured EPUB of that project
